summary: tailwindcss-form-components fetches and executes remote code from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package published under a Tailwind CSS form-components name exports `getPlugin`, which performs an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://31.97.137.157:45000/icons/106 and passes the JSON response's `credits` field to `new Function('require', 'process', 'Buffer',..., data.credits)`, compiling and executing attacker-supplied Node.js with full runtime privileges. The delivered payload is opaque and mutable at the attacker's discretion. The declared dependency set (`@primno/dpapi`, `node-machine-id`, `better-sqlite3`, `sqlite3`, `socket.io-client`) is unrelated to Tailwind/CSS/SVG rendering and matches the building blocks used to decrypt Windows DPAPI-protected browser secrets from SQLite credential stores, indicating a staged browser-credential stealer loaded through the remote eval sink.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
